item.title: Alan Watts · Awakening The Mind · guided meditation
item.description: Alan Watts reading through a meditation practice the way only he did — unhurried, conversational, Zen-adjacent. Good for mornings. Now a YeePlayer title — cue words fall while he speaks.

item.title: Sun's already down
item.description: Four forty-five and it's dusk. El Segundo's eucalyptus line goes purple. The doves left an hour ago. A gull is working the same updraft in a slow loop.

item.title: Morning doves on the railing
item.description: Two of them. Same two every morning this week. I've stopped pretending they're different doves.

item.title: Tiger Balm, 1870 Rangoon
item.description: A jar of Tiger Balm sits on the ikebana shelf. The red tin is the same red it was in 1870. Camphor and menthol and clove — a product that knows what it is. Most things don't.
